meta.topic: Air handling unit (AHU) configuration reference - sensible EN 16798-5-1 model
derived_from: src/pybuildingenergy/source/utils.py (component profile resolution, AHU diagnostic columns)
docs/ventilation_ahu_audit.html (implementation audit shipped with the repository)

reference_standards.chain: ISO 52016-1 (zone heat balance) -> EN 16798-7 (required zone airflow) -> EN 16798-5-1 (AHU and system energy)

EN_16798_5_1.title: Energy performance of buildings - Ventilation for buildings - Part 5-1: Calculation methods for energy requirements of ventilation and air conditioning systems (Methods M5-6, M5-8, M6-5, M6-8, M7-5, M7-8) - Method 1: Distribution and generation
EN_16798_5_1.role: Thermodynamic AHU calculation: sensible heat recovery, frost limit, bypass, coils, fans and fan heat.
clauses_cited_in_code_and_audit: Table B.2 (supply-temperature controller strategies: fixed, outdoor-compensated, load-compensated)
formula (46) (direct frost protection by effectiveness reduction)
formula (77) (heat-recovery bookkeeping, valid only for balanced flow, no recirculation, no ODA preheating, frost correction inactive)

ISO_52016_1.role: Zone coupling: the AHU supply enters the zone balance as one additive stream of the affine ventilation boundary, section 6.5.10, with H_k = rho_air * cp_air * q_supply and source temperature = delivered supply temperature.

EN_16798_7.role: Upstream source of the required airflow (the AHU receives the required flow; the legacy ventilation_type values temp_wind / occupancy / custom implement EN 16798-7 style airflow calculations).

reference_standards.reference_implementation: Fan part-load pressure and efficiency relations follow the EPB Center EN 16798-5-1 reference implementation/spreadsheet (acknowledged in the module docstring).
important_caveats: The module evaluates and demonstrates the calculation approach for a sensible, balanced-airflow subset. It does not replace the standard, which must be consulted alongside it.
supply_temperature_mode 'extract_compensated' is NOT one of the controller modes of Table B.2: it is a generic piecewise-linear extension.
Defaults for fan efficiencies (0.72 / 0.78), fan heat fractions (0.90) and frost limit (-5 degC) are placeholders for product/design data.

not_included: Latent cooling / dehumidification, humidity recovery, humidification (the model is sensible only)
Airflow leakage, AHU casing and duct losses
Unbalanced supply/extract flow (rejected with an error)
Multi-zone air distribution and detailed VAV control (one AHU component serves the zone it is configured in)
Indirect frost treatment and explicit defrost equipment (preheater, recirculation defrost)
Altitude-corrected air density: rho = 1.204 kg/m3, cp = 1006 J/(kg K), rho*cp = 1211.224 J/(m3 K)

three_levels_of_ventilation_modelling.simple_default: legacy ventilation_type values or 'constant_ach' components: outdoor-air stream, no AHU calculation.
three_levels_of_ventilation_modelling.prescribed: 'prescribed' component: you supply H_k and the supply temperature (computed elsewhere).

related_but_different.VentilationSystemCalculator: source/ventilation_16798_5_7.py - simple bilancio with heat-recovery efficiency and fans; no coils, no supply-temperature control, not coupled to the ISO 52016 solver.
related_but_different.ahu_modelica.py: untracked, psychrometric (humidity) prototype needing an EPW reader; not part of the packaged AHU model.

where_to_put_it.multizone: zones[i].ventilation.components  (per zone); if a zone has none, the global building_parameters.ventilation.components list is used
rules: Each component needs a unique, non-empty 'name'; duplicates raise ValueError.
When a 'components' list is present it REPLACES the legacy scalar ventilation_type path for that zone: add a 'constant_ach' component if you also want infiltration.
Components without a 'profile' key run at 1.0 (always on), so infiltration stays active when the AHU schedule is off.
constant_ach needs a positive zone volume: building.zone_volume_m3 (aliases zone_volume, volume) in single zone; zone volume keys in multizone.

sensible_heat_recovery_efficiency.description: Sensible temperature efficiency (0 = no heat recovery).

extract_flow_m3_h.description: Must equal the supply flow (relative difference > 1e-6 raises ValueError: unbalanced flow is out of scope).

description.outdoor_compensated: Piecewise-linear curve on the OUTDOOR temperature (Table B.2 strategy).
description.extract_compensated: Piecewise-linear curve on the EXTRACT (lagged zone air) temperature. Extension beyond Table B.2.

supply_temperature_mode.note: A 'scheduled' mode exists in the Python API (SupplyTemperatureControlMode.SCHEDULED + scheduled_setpoint_c) but is NOT reachable through the dict/JSON component: any other string raises ValueError.

supply_temperature_points.constraints: at least 2 pairs; unique reference temperatures (sorted automatically); values outside the curve are clamped to the end points

supply_temperature_minimum_c.description: Lower clamp of the requested setpoint (all modes).

supply_temperature_maximum_c.description: Upper clamp; minimum must be <= maximum.

description.modulating_bypass: Mixes outdoor air with heat-recovery outlet air to track the supply setpoint; modulates continuously also in economizer conditions (outdoor warmer than extract).
description.always_on: No modulation: the recovery core always operates.

description.exhaust_limit: Reduces the effective efficiency so that the exhaust leaving the core stays at or above frost_exhaust_limit_c (direct approach, formula (46)).

heating_coil_max_power_w.description: null = unlimited. Delivered power is capped; the shortfall is reported in required_heating_coil_power_w.

cooling_coil_enabled.description: Accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off (also as strings). When false the required cooling power is only REPORTED as unmet.

cooling_coil_max_power_w.description: Ignored when the coil is disabled. Sensible cooling only.

supply_fan_specific_power_w_per_m3_s.description: NOMINAL specific fan power at design flow (SFP). Default 0 = NO fan electricity and no fan heat.

supply_fan_heat_fraction_to_air.description: Share of the supply-fan power that heats the supply air (added after the coils; the coil target compensates for it).

extract_fan_heat_fraction_to_air.description: Share of the extract-fan power that heats the extract air BEFORE the heat exchanger. Set 0 for a fan downstream of the heat recovery.

description.en16798_5_1: Design pressure derived from nominal SFP and efficiency (unless given); part load: delta_p = delta_p_design * (q/q_design)^2 and efficiency = eta_ref * sqrt(q/q_ref).
description.constant_sfp: P = q * SFP at every flow.

supply_fan_reference_flow_m3_h.description: Product-data reference flow for the part-load efficiency correction.

profile.description: Name of the profile column giving the CONTINUOUS flow fraction in [0, 1] relative to the design flow (reduced fan speed, not ON/OFF duty cycle). Values outside [0, 1] raise ValueError. null = always 1.0.

missing_profile_policy.description: What to do when 'profile' names a column that is not available. For mechanical_supply the default is 'error' (a misspelt schedule would silently run the AHU at 100%); for the other component types the default is 'warn' (uses 1.0).

air_path_and_formulas.order: outdoor air -> sensible heat recovery (frost-limited, modulating bypass) -> cooling coil -> heating coil -> supply fan heat -> supply stream. Extract: zone air -> extract fan heat -> heat-recovery exhaust side -> exhaust (frost check).
air_path_and_formulas.extract_temperature: PREVIOUS-timestep zone air-node temperature (not operative): explicit lag that avoids the T_zone -> T_extract -> T_supply -> T_zone algebraic loop.
steps: requested supply setpoint from the controller (clamped by min/max)
fan power and fan temperature rise: dT_fan = P_fan * heat_fraction / (rho*cp*q)
T_extract_at_HR = T_extract + dT_extract_fan ; dT = T_extract_at_HR - T_outdoor
frost: if T_EHA = T_extract_at_HR - eta*dT < limit then eta_eff = (T_extract_at_HR - limit) / dT (clamped to [0, eta])
T_after_HR = T_outdoor + eta_eff*dT ; modulating bypass mixes outdoor air to reach T_target = T_setpoint - dT_supply_fan
cooling coil = rho*cp*q*max(0, T_after_HR - T_target) (only delivered if enabled, capped by max power)
heating coil = rho*cp*q*max(0, T_target - T_after_cooling) (capped by max power)
air_path_and_formulas.zone_coupling: H_k = 1211.224 * supply_flow_m3_h / 3600 [W/K], source temperature = delivered supply temperature; zero flow -> zero conductance.

columns.Q_ahu_cool_req: required sensible cooling-coil power [W] (exposes unmet demand when the coil is disabled or capped)
columns.T_ahu_sup_req: requested supply temperature [degC] (NaN when the AHU is off)
columns.ahu_bypass: effective bypass fraction (frost + modulation), not a damper position

diagnostic_hourly_columns.energy_bookkeeping: Coil energy is a SYSTEM-side diagnostic and is deliberately NOT added to the zone energy balance/Sankey (the zone ventilation term already uses the conditioned supply temperature: adding it would double count). Convert W to kWh yourself (multiply by the time step). P_ahu_fan is an electric load that can be added to E_site_el_load_kWh for the PV calculator.

usage: out = calculate_sensible_ahu_step(cfg, AHUStepInputs(outdoor_temperature_c=..., extract_temperature_c=..., required_supply_flow_m3_h=..., required_extract_flow_m3_h=..., operation_fraction=1.0, flow_fraction=1.0))

AHUStepInputs_extra.operation_fraction: ON/OFF duty fraction [0, 1] (only in the standalone API; the solver fixes it at 1.0)
AHUStepInputs_extra.flow_fraction: continuous flow ratio [0, 1] (the solver maps the component profile to it)

ahu_fixed_supply_basic.description: Balanced AHU 600 m3/h, 75% heat recovery, fixed 19 degC supply, no cooling.

ahu_outdoor_compensated_with_cooling_coi.description: Weather-compensated supply (21 degC at -10 degC outdoor, 18 degC at 15 degC), capped coils, cooling coil enabled.

ahu_extract_compensated.description: Supply temperature reduced as the room warms (extension beyond EN 16798-5-1 Table B.2): 21 degC supply at 20 degC extract, 17 degC at 26 degC.

ahu_with_manufacturer_fan_data.description: Fans described by product data: design pressure, efficiencies and reference flow for the part-load correction; extract fan downstream of the heat recovery (no extract-fan heat).

ahu_simple_no_frost_no_bypass.description: Simplest hardware: recovery always on, no frost control, constant-SFP fans, unlimited heating coil.

prescribed_supply_alternative.description: When the supply condition is computed elsewhere: fixed conductance and supply temperature (no AHU physics).

single_zone_building_snippet.description: Where the AHU sits in a single-zone building JSON, together with infiltration (always on).

multizone_zone_snippet.description: Per-zone AHU in a multizone building JSON (zones[i].ventilation.components).
